paragraphs.text: Download delivered, changed, and previewed files from the DSH Web GUI; hide native open controls tha
t cannot work in headless or remote deployments.
# dsh-cloud-download
Download files that DeepSeek Harness delivers or previews **straight from the conversation** — no SF
TP, no backend file manager, no detour to the NAS.
Built for DSH running on a remote host, in a container, on a NAS, or behind a reverse proxy, where t
he browser is on your machine but the files are on the Host.
## What you get
| Where | What it adds |

| Delivery card (`present`) | A download icon next to the native open control |
| Changed-files revi

ew (right sidebar) | A download icon in the review header |
| Document preview header | A download i

con for the file being previewed |
| Unsupported-preview empty state | A labeled “Download file” but

or the file being previewed |
| Unsupported-preview empty state | A labeled “Download file” button |
The download icons show their own state: **Preparing download…**, **Download started**, or **Downloa
d failed. Click to retry.** A failed request also shows the server's HTTP status and reason in a sho
rt toast, instead of the browser's generic “download failed” message.
## Why this plugin exists
A remote DSH Host often exposes the native “show file location” / “open in file manager” actions. Th
ey report success, but the file manager opens on the Host's desktop — which the remote browser canno
t see. On a NAS or cloud container that desktop may be Xvfb, a display with no viewer at all.
This plugin:

- adds a real browser download path that works over the network;
- hides those dead native open cont

rols by default;
- documents how to restore them on a real desktop.
## How the download works
1. The browser sends a `HEAD` request to the plugin's authenticated route. A successful probe means

the file is readable and the Host can stream it.
2. The browser's own download manager then fetches

the attachment URL, so even a large file streams to disk instead of being buffered in page memory.
3
. A failed probe is followed by one `GET` so the Host's error text can be shown in the toast.
Delivery and review downloads carry only the coordinates the official card already has — Session, du
rable event sequence, and file index. No path or extra capability crosses the wire; the Host resolve
s the path from the Session log and confines it to the configured workspace root. A path outside tha
t root returns `403` instead of being read.
The preview header reuses DSH's built-in `/api/file` route, which needs an absolute Host path and ca
ps a single file at roughly 20 MiB. For larger files, download from the delivery card or the review
single file at roughly 20 MiB. For larger files, download from the delivery card or the review page.

sktop where those controls do work, restore them once:

## Install
From this repository:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
An npm release is planned under the same name; GitHub install works today.
Then reload the browser page. The package ships built `index.js` and `client.js`; the TypeScript sou
rces live in `src/` and are compiled at build/release time.
**Requires a DSH Web build that exposes the four per-file slots listed above** (developed against DS
H 0.2.x). On a Host without those slots the plugin stays inert rather than replacing the official ca
.2.x). On a Host without those slots the plugin stays inert rather than replacing the official card.
## Limits

- The preview route is limited by DSH's `/api/file` (~20 MiB).
- Delivery and review downloads are c

onfined to the Host's configured workspace root. Files outside it are rejected with `403`.
- This pl

ugin downloads single files. It does not upload, scan folders, or build ZIP archives.
- It does not
bypass DSH's session/filesystem authorization.
## Related plugins
- `dsh-save-button` — download from delivery cards, with a compatibility layer for older DSH lines.
- `dsh-file-transfer` — confirmed download/upload in the preview toolbar and Files tree, including f
e-transfer` — confirmed download/upload in the preview toolbar and Files tree, including folder ZIP.
This plugin is intentionally narrower: one download action across the card, the changed-files review
, and the preview, plus the headless native-control cleanup.
## Development
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The Host half registers one authenticated route at `/api/cloud.download`; the browser half registers
four additive slots. No DSH core package is patched. The TypeScript build emits the runtime JS at t
he package root so existing installs keep working unchanged.
